data.one_liner: Fast Markdown parser and canvas renderer for Flutter with text selection and streaming.
data.what_it_does: Parses and renders Markdown text on a Flutter canvas with custom render objects. Supports cross-widget text selection, streaming parsing for LLM token outputs, and opt-in syntax highlighting.
use_when: Displaying markdown text from AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini
Streaming markdown content token by token into chat interfaces
Requiring robust cross-block and cross-widget text selection for markdown
avoid_when: You only need to display plain non-markdown text
You do not need custom canvas-rendered markdown features
strengths: High performance parser and renderer with optimized streaming support
Cross-block and cross-widget text selection surviving list disposals
Dependency-free code-block syntax highlighting with 65+ languages
weaknesses: API updates between minor versions may require adjustments for custom painters or selection surfaces
Advanced customizations require understanding custom render objects and specialized scopes
data.setup_notes: No native platform steps or permissions required.
